entities.name: Saint Bartolomew Church in Vrahovice
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: St. Bartholomew's Church is a baroque building which was built from 1831 to 1836 and which is used by a Catholic Church. It lies at the main square in Vrahovice. The church is protected as a cultural monument of the Czech Republic.
